record: Clemson University Athletics standing venue description
facts: Memorial Stadium consists of the field, both upper decks, WestZone complex and east videoboard. The media press box is on the south side of the stadium.
The installed east videoboard is 126 feet wide and 56.5 feet high, with its underside approximately 20 feet above the east entrance grade.
The lower western seating and subsequent WestZone enclose the west end of the stadium. The eastern green-grass section is distinct.
